summary: The two resume sources have no execution-blocking finding. Independent same-arm native/formal flow, same-arm NORMAL_READY acceptance, paired closure and exact archive ACK path are sound in this bounded source review. One nonblocking stale current-dataset status field should be reset before the next dataset. Runtime execution and performance are not established.

nonblocking_findings.title: Clear accepted native arms when current_dataset changes
nonblocking_findings.evidence: state is shared across the dataset loop. MSVR NATIVE_ARM_PASS stores both names at line123; line103 switches to RGBNT100 without resetting native_arms_accepted, leaving stale accepted names until a new RGB arm event. The receiver-local arms set is separately reset at line108.
nonblocking_findings.impact: The live status JSON can temporarily attribute MSVR acceptance to RGBNT100. It does not bypass any launch, archive, pair-native or final-closure gate.
nonblocking_findings.minimal_change: Set native_arms_accepted=[] in the per-dataset state.update at line103.
